newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: BARLOW, NEDCOR UNIT IN JOINT VENTURE.
newsitem.headline: BARLOW, NEDCOR UNIT IN JOINT VENTURE.

text.p: Barlow Ltd and NedEnterprise, a division of Nedcor, said on Tuesday they had joined forces to develop entrepreneurs in the local earthmoving and construction industries.

"The partnership adds weight to the Emerging Contractor Programme (ECP), an initiative launched two years ago by Barlows Equipment Co, the leading earthmoving equipment supplier in southern Africa," the companies said in a statement.
In terms of the new agreement, Barlows will continue to identify suitable candidates, while NedEnterprise provides access to finance.
The ECP seeks to develop emerging contractors and facilitate their access to the mainstream economy, thereby supporting the Reconstruction and Development Programme (RDP).
The statement said that the ECP had already assisted more than 27 individuals to start independent construction businesses.
